title: SSC CPO Quant
summary: SSC CPO Paper I Quantitative Aptitude past questions from 16 shifts, 2024 to 2025, five a day. Questions SSC asked again and the question types it keeps asking come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question.
note: Repeats are counted across the 16 SSC CPO Paper I shifts, June 2024 and December 2025, including questions SSC reprinted word for word. SSC writes fresh questions for almost every shift, so a question it asks again usually comes back with new numbers, and most of the order comes from question types. Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF_SSC.md) and checked in the main session. Questions marked defective are left out.
